purpose: Physical rigid bodies of the Vitruvian rig (phase 3 input). Animation bones and physics bodies are separate: 16 bodies drive 29 animation bones. Each body owns one 'driver' bone (the PhysicalBone3D's bone) and lists the animation bones that ride on it kinematically.
mass_source: de Leva P. (1996), J Biomech 29(9):1223-1230, adult male segment mass fractions (percent of body mass): head+neck 6.94, trunk 43.46 split into lower (11.17), middle (16.33) and upper (15.96) trunk, upper arm 2.71, forearm 1.62, hand 0.61, thigh 14.16, shank 4.33, foot 1.37.

thorax.segment: upper trunk (UPT); the clavicles follow it until the girdle is simulated

lod.reduced: 10 bodies: pelvis, trunk (abdomen+thorax), head, arms as upper arm + forearm-with-hand, legs as thigh + shank-with-foot
lod.minimal: 1 capsule (no ragdoll): distant characters keep authored animation only

armour_note: Armour adds mass per body (and widens shapes) without changing the skeleton; strength and joint resistance are per-joint dynamics in joint_limits.json (phase 3).
